# Sinks bound in a language where no check bound in that language can neutralise
# the threat. Each line is `threat<TAB>language`.
#
# This is a work list, not an exemption list. Every line is resolved one of two
# ways:
#
#   - bind the missing check in that language, where the control applies there;
#   - unbind the sink in that language, where the threat cannot occur there.
#
# Removing a line without doing one of those fails the test, and doing one without
# removing the line fails it too. When this file is empty, delete it and let the
# test fail on any orphan at all.
